sentence: This project studies how microRNA-128 regulates postnatal astroglial development and how losing it in brain astroglial cells affects fragile X syndrome.
This project looks for features of neural progenitors that predict how well brain organoids develop regional patterning, cell types and neural maturation.
This project uses a high-throughput screening platform to find small molecules that restore function to a protein that mislocalizes and aggregates in disease.

This project studies how pathogenic variants disrupt fatty acid oxidation and cardiolipin remodeling, causing lipid peroxidation and mitochondrial dysfunction in mitochondrial trifunctional protein deficiency.
This project builds software tools that let scientists analyze raw data from DNA sequencers, search public archives and measure evolutionary distances between genomic sequences.
This project improves a cloud platform for spatial metabolomics by adding machine learning to identify metabolites for use in cancer research.
This project builds deep learning software tools to find genes in mosquito vectors involved in adaptations such as resistance to insecticides.
This project prepares and stores samples from patients with severe pneumonia and runs sequencing tests to study host and pathogen interactions.
This project builds a photon-counting detector CT and deep learning tools that reduce image noise and correct motion artifacts when imaging coronary artery disease.
This project coordinates a network of clinical research on rare vascular malformation disorders and supports work with patient advocates.
This project studies how a ring of actin filaments and myosin produces the force that separates one cell into two during cytokinesis in fission yeast.
This project uses reverse metabolomics and big data mining to find molecules made by microbes that are linked to inflammatory bowel disease.
This project builds a research community of investigators and community members to create solutions that improve health, including for obesity and cancer.
This project provides preclinical imaging, including positron emission tomography and bioluminescence imaging, to test whether ferroptosis plays a major role in resistance to radiation therapy.
This project builds a machine learning method that learns complementary features from multimodal biomedical data for trustworthy AI in clinical use.
This project applies data science and artificial intelligence techniques to genomics of human diseases.
This project studies what leads to heavy drinking as it happens in bisexual and heterosexual women with and without histories of sexual assault.
This project uses multi-omics and immuno-engineering approaches to study the tumor immune microenvironment in alveolar soft part sarcoma and find therapeutic vulnerabilities.
This project studies how radiotherapy and immunotherapy can work better in ovarian clear cell carcinoma by using DNA damage to trigger innate immune responses.
This project studies how often obstructive sleep apnea goes undiagnosed in primary care and builds a way to find it using electronic medical records.
